name: Tango Charlie
summary:
Inspired by the Bollywood film Tango Charlie, this single-player VR experience immerses you in the life of an Indian Army sepoy on a mission deep in the jungles of Manipur.
Begin with a rigorous training session—mastering firearms, grenades, and survival skills like crawling under barbed wire—to prepare for the battles ahead. Dropped off by truck into hostile territory, your first task is to reach the base camp while avoiding hidden traps and enemy ambushes.
